label: Where terrain pools water
source: ICGC 5 m terrain model (terrain-RGB tiles, zoom 12)

low.rule: depression >= 0.05 m, or flat lowland (slope < 0.01 and elevation < 15 m)

method: Priority-flood sink filling on ~143 m cells gives the depression depth (filled minus original elevation) and a central-difference slope per cell; cells are classed by depth, with flat lowland added at the low tier. Terrain shape only, no rain, no drainage and no runoff: a diagnostic of where ground can hold water, not a simulation of flooding.
